title: Up to the Seventh Floor
搬上七樓
paras: Asha Mehta had spent three weeks planning the {{relocation|relocation}} of Northgate Design from the third floor to the seventh. She had drawn the new {{layout|layout}}: twelve desks along the windows, a small kitchen in the corner, and a {{boardroom|boardroom}} with a long table where the directors would hold their monthly meetings.
艾莎·梅塔花了三個星期，規劃 Northgate 設計公司從三樓搬到七樓的事。她畫好新的配置圖：十二張辦公桌沿著窗邊排開，角落有間小茶水間，還有一間董事會議室，裡面的長桌是給董事開月會用的。

On Saturday morning, the {{installation|installation}} of the new {{copier|copier}} was the first job. The technician, Leo, rolled it into the hall and frowned. "There's no {{cartridge|cartridge}} in the box," he said. "Without toner, it won't print a single page." Asha remembered two spare cartridges in the supply closet on the old floor. She ran {{downstairs|downstairs}} and grabbed them.
週六早上，第一件事是安裝新影印機。技術人員里奧把機器推進走廊，皺起了眉頭。「箱子裡沒有碳粉匣，」他說，「沒有碳粉，一張都印不出來。」艾莎想起舊樓層的備品櫃裡還有兩個備用的碳粉匣。她跑下樓去拿。

The real surprise came at five o'clock, when the elevator opened and Mr. Diaz, the evening {{cleaner|cleaner}}, stepped out with his cart. "The guard sent me up. The third floor is empty," he said. Asha's stomach dropped. She had forgotten to {{notify|notify}} the cleaning company about the move.
真正的意外發生在五點，電梯門一開，晚班清潔工迪亞茲先生推著他的推車走了出來。「警衛叫我上來。三樓整層都空了，」他說。艾莎心頭一沉。她忘了通知清潔公司搬家的事。

"I'm so sorry," she said. "This floor is covered in construction dust." Mr. Diaz smiled. "Give me two hours." He pulled a {{vacuum|vacuum}} off his cart and began running it over the carpet. By seven, the floors were spotless. On Monday morning, the team walked in, and nobody guessed how close the move had come to ending in a mess.
「真的很抱歉，」她說，「這層到處都是裝潢留下的灰塵。」迪亞茲先生笑了笑。「給我兩個小時。」他從推車上抽出一台吸塵器，開始在地毯上一路吸過去。到了七點，地板乾淨得發亮。週一早上，同事們走進來，沒人知道這次搬遷差一點就以一團混亂收場。
